dogecoin.text: Much WOW! $DOGE has shattered records to reach a new all-time high at $0.10. The #cryptocurrency has found support from @ElonMusk who joined the #DogeArmy in 2021. Are you bullish on #Dogecoin?

Is #Dogecoin more than just a #meme? Could it possibly be the #cryptocurrency of the future? We shouldn't jump the gun, but $DOGE liquidations briefly surpassed #Bitcoin on April 24, signaling higher demand for the meme-based cryptocurrency. The rise of DOGE continues!
